annotations.title: Any section of an FDA drug label

description: Any section of an FDA drug label — Verbatim text of any section of a drug's official FDA label: pregnancy, lactation, dosing, overdosage, drug interactions, adverse reactions, mechanism of action, pediatric and geriatric use, boxed warning, storage, pharmacokinetics and more. Without section= it lists the sections available on that label. name= brand or generic, optional section= comma list (shortcuts accepted) and max_chars=. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: fda_label_section
